output.reason: A 70-year-old on warfarin with head trauma yesterday now reporting bad headache and two episodes of vomiting requires immediate emergency CT and possible anticoagulation reversal, which messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. You are on warfarin and hit your head yesterday, and a bad headache with vomiting can mean bleeding around the brain that needs urgent CT scanning and possible reversal of your blood thinner. Do not drive yourself and do not wait for a reply here. If anyone is with you, have them stay with you until help arrives.
differential: Subdural or other intracranial hemorrhage after head trauma on anticoagulation
